items.title: Cebu’s Juvey Veloso earns ICA pickleball coach educator certification
items.summary: Juvey Veloso has become one of three ICA-certified pickleball coach educators in the Philippines. Based in Cebu, he can train and assess aspiring coaches locally, reducing the need to travel elsewhere for certification. His first Cebu City course is scheduled for November 28.
items.image_alt: Juvey Veloso with fellow pickleball coaches and educators

items.title: Nxled sweeps Capital1 to stay unbeaten in PVL
items.summary: Nxled defeated Capital1 in straight sets, 25–13, 25–20, 25–18, to improve to 5–0 in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Brooke Van Sickle led with 13 points, while MJ Phillips added nine as the Chameleons claimed the outright lead.
items.image_alt: Nxled Chameleons in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series

items.title: Unbeaten UST women book UAAP Final Four place
items.summary: UST’s Growling Tigresses secured a UAAP Season 89 Final Four berth with a 95–48 win over FEU. Oma Onianwa scored 25 points as the defending champions remained unbeaten at 10–0, while Karylle Sierba added 13 points.
items.image_alt: UST Growling Tigresses in their UAAP women’s basketball game against FEU

items.title: Taduran keeps IBF crown with unanimous win over Moreno
items.summary: Pedro Taduran retained his IBF minimumweight championship with a unanimous-decision victory over Spain’s Brandon Moreno in Albuquerque. The Filipino boxer completed his fourth consecutive successful title defence, improving to 21–4–1 while handing Moreno the first defeat of his professional career.
items.image_alt: Pedro Taduran featured in GMA News’ report on his IBF title defence

items.title: Soyud and Lacsina power Akari past Choco Mucho in five sets
items.summary: Akari survived a five-set battle against Choco Mucho to level its PVL Siklab Series record at 3–3. Eli Soyud and Ivy Lacsina each scored 17 points, with Lacsina also contributing 11 digs and 14 excellent receptions.
items.image_alt: Eli Soyud of Akari playing against Choco Mucho in the PVL Siklab Series

items.title: Acido leads UST to one-point win over FEU
items.summary: UST halted a three-game losing run with an 86–85 victory over FEU in UAAP Season 89. Amiel Acido led the Growling Tigers with 23 points, helping improve their record to 5–6 as FEU slipped to 6–5.
items.image_alt: Amiel Acido of the UST Growling Tigers in UAAP Season 89

items.title: Deloria earns weekly PVL award after Galeries Tower breakthrough
items.summary: Erika Deloria earned PVL Press Corps Player of the Week honours for November 3–7 after helping Galeries Tower secure its first Siklab Series victory. She scored 20 points and delivered 28 excellent receptions in the five-set win over Akari.
items.image_alt: Erika Deloria of Galeries Tower in the PVL All-Filipino Conference

items.title: Eala closes milestone season with Hong Kong runner-up finish
items.summary: Alex Eala finished her 2026 season as Hong Kong Open runner-up. Her year included a maiden WTA singles title in Washington, a Birmingham WTA 125 crown, and appearances in Wimbledon’s last 16 and the US Open’s last 32.

items.title: Quezon Memorial Circle opens free pickleball courts
items.summary: Two pickleball courts have opened at Quezon Memorial Circle, offering free play for Quezon City residents, with non-residents also welcome. Players can request a slot by email and should bring their own paddle, ball and reusable water bottle.
items.image_alt: Pickleball courts at Quezon Memorial Circle

items.title: NU edges La Salle to strengthen UAAP Final Four bid
items.summary: National University beat La Salle 84–80 in UAAP Season 89. Reinhard Jumamoy contributed 21 points, including 14 in the final quarter, as NU improved its record to eight wins and three losses.
